story.title: MIT blueprint: redesigning information architecture could let AI strengthen democracy
story.summary: A new MIT-affiliated research blueprint argues that AI could reinforce democratic participation if information systems are deliberately redesigned rather than left to market forces. The authors draw historical parallels to the printing press and telegraph, which reshaped governance in their eras, and call for policy intervention to guide AI's role in civic life. The paper proposes specific architectural changes to platforms and public information infrastructure to prioritise verified, deliberative discourse.
